competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may be outdated, promotional, or refer to a different item category or exchange-only window.
hypothesis_statement: The current full-refund return window for standard items is 30 days from the date of delivery.
refutation_criterion: An authoritative current policy source states that standard items have a full-refund return window that is not 30 days, or that full refunds are unavailable within 30 days.
